help_pollInterval: How often each account is queried. The floor of 60 s keeps the providers from throttling you; 300 s is plenty for windows that move in hours.
help_notifications: One notification when an account crosses its warn threshold or its credentials stop working.
aboutInfo: This adapter is free and open source. If you find it useful, consider supporting the development.
descConnection: True as soon as at least one AI account is delivering data.
nameTotalMaxPercent: Highest account utilisation (limit window or budget)
nameTotalLimitReached: An account is at 100 % (limit window or budget)
descUnreach: True while this account is not delivering data. A throttle keeps the last values and leaves it false.
descLastError: Why this account delivers nothing. Empty while all is well; "Unknown" while the adapter itself has nothing to report.
descWarning: True while a plan-wide window is above the warn threshold of this account. A single model's window never raises it.
descLimitReached: True when a plan-wide window is at 100 % or the provider reports it as locked. A single model at its cap does not count.
descWindowActive: True while this window is the limit the account runs into next. Exactly one window per account carries it.
descWindowResetAt: When this window starts over. Empty while no window is running — the provider reports no reset time then.
descResetCredits: Purchasable vouchers that clear a full limit window. Counted from the provider's list, expired ones left out.
descCostsProjected: Projected spend at month end, computed from what was spent so far — not a figure the provider reports.
descTotalMaxPercent: The fullest account: its plan-wide window or its remaining budget, whichever is higher.
